Using LCM \(96\):
\[
\frac{7}{12}=\frac{56}{96},\quad \frac{11}{24}=\frac{44}{96},\quad \frac{13}{16}=\frac{78}{96},\quad \frac{3}{32}=\frac{9}{96}.
\]
The fraction attending exactly two clubs is
\[
\frac{56+44+78-96-2\cdot 9}{96}
=\frac{64}{96}
=\frac23.
\]
So the number would be
\[
800\cdot \frac23=\frac{1600}{3},
\]
which is not a whole number. Therefore the given data are inconsistent.

\[
\boxed{\text{No such school exists}}
\]
